preconditions.description: The number of integers n must be even.
The number of integers n must be between 2 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= 2 * 10**5 for x in even_indices)
preconditions.description: All even-indexed integers must be positive and within the range of 1 to 200,000.

postconditions.description: The output must either be 'No' or start with 'Yes' followed by n integers.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= 10**13 for x in output_sequence)
postconditions.description: All output integers must be positive and within the range of 1 to 10^13.
The cumulative sums of the output sequence must be perfect squares.
